sections.label: J

questions.explanation: A verb used as the subject takes the -ing form: Swimming is easy.
Love can be followed by a verb in the -ing form: love dancing.
Add -ing to ski: skiing. The activity is the subject of is fun.
Use go + activity in the -ing form: go fishing.
